# Welcome to my personal website!

This is my personal website.

Hi, I’m Eva. I’m currently a Master’s student in Biostatistics at Columbia University Mailman School of Public Health, with a focus on Public Health Data Science.

I have a background in mathematical economics and finance, and I’m interested in statistical modeling, data analysis, and applying quantitative methods to real-world problems.

Feel free to check out my [Resume](resume.html) or reach out via email.
